correctness.rationale: For positive q, detailed balance π_iP_ij=q_iq_j/(1-Σq_j²), and 2- and 3-step returns imply aperiodicity. The finite-state joint empirical flow rate J=ΣQ_ij log(Q_ij/(ν_iP_ij)) applies to balanced Q with zero diagonal. Necessity ν_i≤1/2 follows from outgoing flow; sufficiency via symmetric t_ij=(ν_i+ν_j-ν_k)/2=1/2-ν_k. Reversible P gives J(Q^T)=J(Q), so strict convexity forces unique symmetric minimizer; on 3 nodes symmetric row sums determine Q*_ij=t_ij. Substitution yields the displayed rate including boundary with xlogx convention; KL zero only at stationary π. Compact gap between unique optimum and other flows yields double-limit Gibbs conditioning for interior ν, R*_ij=t_ij/ν_i independent of q. Independently tested reversible stationary identities, balanced flow, and strict objective increase under nonzero cyclic circulation for 16 parameter combinations. Finite tests are not LDP proof.
